scope: Current ordinary player v2/manual/fresh/bounded/centerline, limb sever ON, g9.81, finish rule player only; opponent physics/controllers legacy. Natural exposure failed; controlled actual native contacts successful. No production edits owned by this experiment.

execution.grouping: 4 natural conditions × legacy/armorCausal; 4 controlled fixtures × legacy/armorCausal first boundary; same4 controlled fixtures × legacy/armorGuard+120follow; corrected autoGuardfalse replay of all8 guard fixtures and2 representative LSplate natural rows. 34 runs including10 correction/equivalence reruns, not34 independent conditions.

protocol.natural: Start gap5.6m, normal longsword opponent AI, player waits240ticks then approaches with joystick and repeats authored hand deltas, triggers real thrust only after observed live enemy down+finish.on. Player requests recorded by baseline and replayed exactly by candidate. Opponent look LOOKS.enemy or Heinrich plate look; Heinrich persona/difficulty not substituted. Max3000ticks25s or first death/disarm.
protocol.controlled: Start gap2.4m; at creation enemy knockDown(true), downTime1e9, enemy AI inputs idle. First30steps apply -x 40*DT*4 impulse to chest AND head each step (40Ns per body;80Ns combined), then native settle through300ticks, normal joystick approach toward torso distance .65m (timeout780), wait90ticks, single real skill.thrust(). No direct position/velocity/cache/wound assignment. Fresh+bounded+centerline/v2 throughout. New guard run continues120steps after baseline death with identical requested input.
protocol.playerEmotion: Harness neutral; full main emotional feedback not simulated.
protocol.contactPath: Fighter.step/cacheState → Rapier world.step(filterContactPair/predict) → Combat.afterStep → actual strike/applyWound (when gates allow) and rebound/cutting; observers do not replace these methods outputs.
protocol.ordinaryScope: Player settings and game physics match current defaults. Natural opponent uses Heinrich armor appearance plus normal/default harness AI, not published Heinrich persona/difficulty; no claim of identical published-opponent behavior.

naturalResult.judgment: Not exposed; retained negative finding, no natural finishing-efficacy claim.

controlledContactResults.reboundScope: Matched first finish contact only; both retain chest plate after damage. Later dynamics diverge after death/survival; no general recoil equivalence claim.
Matched first finish contact only; both retain chest plate after damage. Later dynamics diverge after death/survival; no general recoil equivalence claim.

reusedPriorComponents.scope: Old61 components document equality/below-bare/noarmor/ignoreArmor/worn armor/player-only/normal head death/daze/blunt gates. New armorGuard low-energy-band coverage is separate root-owned test evidence; this report does not relabel old61 as new-policy validation.
reusedPriorComponents.currentRootRun: Root reports old61 rerun after armorGuard edits and new63 checks passed; zero physics steps. Their current artifacts belong to root-owned aggregate, separate from this lane native count and historical61 raw.

limitations: No natural finishing opportunity in selected small fixed set; no seed or gain sweep.
Controlled victim is held down and AI-idled with explicit initial impulse; this is not natural play or full phone acceptance.
New guard is physically exposed only between bare and armored thresholds here; below-bare rule difference is not physically exposed and requires separate component evidence.
Helmet/head daze and normal concussion death are not freshly exposed by these chest fixtures; unchanged old61 components are reused.
First armor rebound matches because live plate coverage remains present in both; armor-break/wear-material divergence outside this range is untested.
Post-impact A/B divergence follows death/survival and armor damage; do not infer later single-contact momentum benefit.
External raw/frozen sources/dependencies are required; source manifests hash shared original node_modules, which were stable during each run.
No production adoption, browser verification or peer-material reading performed by this lane.
decision: Research evidence supports a separate player-only armorGuard comparison at actual blocked chest contacts; ordinary legacy rule remains an intentional approved exception. Product/default adoption is outside this experiment.
next: Use separate low-band component tests plus root-owned comparison entry and delivery checks; do not repeat broad native suites for documentation changes.

setupCorrection.issue: Probe initially assigned autoGuard=true after applySwordsmanship sets false. Published player uses false. The flag was dormant because applySwordsmanship sets skill.level=0 and skill.js canRecover requires level>=.35. Corrected source asserts false and records both values.
setupCorrection.conclusion: All eight controlled full traces and representative natural LSplate pair are exact after correction; no new efficacy samples. Remaining six original natural rows retain explicitly recorded dormant-flag setup mismatch, not relabeled as reruns.
setupCorrection.metadataCorrection: Earlier raw preparation string ambiguously said chest/head total40Ns. Executed loop supplies40Ns to EACH body=80Ns combined; code physics is unchanged. Latest probe/report wording corrects this.
